selection: Both profitable context_strict holdout trades; all six accepted textual units reviewed with surrounding captions.
chart_note: Post-outcome source review: both strict-variant trades fail the intended current-BTC interpretation. See the report.

findings.reason: One positive cue describes an indicator midband position. The other bullish stance depends on a future reclaim. Neither supports an unconditional current Bitcoin long view.

All three negative units concern MSTR/MSTZ or Monero, with Bitcoin mentioned as a comparison or explicitly separate subject. A remaining Bitcoin bounce expectation does not support the aggregate short.

interpretation: The frozen positive return is a numerical result of the heuristic, not evidence that correctly extracted Krown Bitcoin views were profitable. This targeted diagnostic cannot estimate corpus-wide precision or recall.
next_gate: Fix subject, condition and proposition representation, then measure extraction accuracy against independent labels on fresh unseen sources before further performance claims.
